name: Midnight Sapphire
description: A deep, velvety blue with an almost ink-like saturation. This unheated oval carries a quiet, exceptional glow.

name: Garden Emerald
description: A vivid green emerald with a lively garden of inclusions and a beautifully balanced rectangular cut.

name: Rosecut Ruby
description: A glowing raspberry-red ruby, rose-cut by hand to preserve its natural, softly luminous character.

name: Golden Beryl
description: Warm champagne tones meet a bright, open cut in this generous golden beryl from Minas Gerais.

name: Twilight Spinel
description: A rare violet-grey spinel with a moody shift in changing light and a crisp cushion cut.

name: Seafoam Tourmaline
description: A fresh seafoam tourmaline with extraordinary clarity and a soft, watery gradient of colour.
